notes: Source whole image is 2369 x 1686 pixels; half a is 1244 x 1686 and half b is 1245 x 1686. Whole, a and b were viewed once each in that order; each of six crops was viewed once. No OCR, recognition, PDF text layer, other page or other reader output was used.

The sheet is handwritten throughout. No title, date, running prose or manuscript folio is visible. The isolated lower-left 1 is retained as an archive sheet-number comment, not a manuscript page number. No typed or printed reused material was found.

The upper region contains subdivided intervals, several small divided strips, hatched oval/lens forms, two long separating curves and an unhatched double lobe. They carry no secure lexical labels apart from unresolved ink inside the first of three lenses.

A chain of five parenthesized names is followed below by Fx to Fy and then x <= y with curved marks beneath the variables. This is an observation of the ink; no categorical assertion or theorem was proved or repaired.
No explicit authorial doubt, question word or question mark could be identified. The in-place uncertainties are reader doubts. The number of words represented by the dense lens ink is not secure.

H_drawing.tex was read as an additional drawing witness. Its comments acknowledge regularisation and omitted central scribble. The current H prose correctly gives three, four and five total interval marks; the older contradictory count quoted inside an H drawing comment is editorial history, not manuscript text.

C drawing was reused after element-by-element checking. Only the first chained lens upper-left gap and two low hooks were amended; its other individual contours, hatch positions, strokes and dots were retained. The lower-right nonlinguistic marks were added with explicit uncertainty as to their origin.

The source does not let me establish an independent former superset beneath the heavily retraced Cat arrow. The live hooked arrow is secure, but the proposed earlier stage has been omitted rather than represented as a second deleted token.

notation.evidence: Tall capital S followed by a smaller s, a space, and sets with a separately crossed t; no hyphen.
Large right return plus separate rounded left point. Hooked left arrow is favoured; inclusion remains possible.
Left head visibly retraced; right shaft turns upward and left into a hook. No independent cancelled sign is secure.
Open-left curves between third and fourth names and between fourth and fifth names; no separate left head securely identified in the halves.
Acute over é secure. Old strokes cross the o/O region, preventing a decisive case reading.

notation.reading: ordinary single-stroke C and O capitals
notation.evidence: One main open C curve and one oval O; no intentional doubled alphabet.
Struck T-r-i-a-n-g; final g descender ends the word, no securely visible abbreviation dot.
Repeated tall stems with right upper and middle arms, no stem-crossing or lowercase descender; x/y occupy the following baseline.
Separate shallow upward-opening arcs, not straight underlines. The long y tail crosses its arc.

brief_feedback: The whole and supplied halves are left/right splits, despite drawing rows naturally lying above the text; recording the half offsets in the packet would simplify coordinate bookkeeping. The instruction to account for all ink does not explicitly distinguish marginal reproduction specks from manuscript marks, so the lower-right cluster was inspected once and conservatively traced with an origin-uncertain note.
